channel.description: Reddit r/RStudio 서브레딧에서 최근 2시간 동안 작성된 글들입니다.

item.title: When RStudio crashes right after you forgot to save for 2 hours
item.description: Nothing humbles you faster than watching your unsaved ggplot masterpiece vanish like a puff of smoke. Meanwhile, VSCode users smirk in auto-save safety like smug time travelers. Save early, save often, or perish in the spinning wheel of doom.
